title: "Privacy Policy"

*Effective November 13, 2026. This policy covers the website at slamdunk.bet, operated by Slam Dunk Betting Services LLC ("Slam Dunk Bets", "we").*

## What this site collects

This website has no accounts, forms, or comment sections. Apart from the ad-measurement pixel described under "Advertising and affiliate links" below, the only data it collects is **anonymous usage analytics** through Google Analytics 4: pages viewed, approximate location derived from a truncated IP address, device and browser type, the site that referred you, and clicks on our subscribe and app links. Google Analytics sets cookies to tell repeat visits apart. We use this to understand which pages and links are useful; we don't sell it, and we can't identify you from it.

You can opt out with the [Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout), by blocking cookies for this site in your browser, or by using a content blocker.

## Services with their own policies

Subscribing, paying, and receiving picks all happen on other companies' platforms, each governed by its own privacy policy:

- **Sharpduel** and **Whop** handle checkout, billing, and subscription management. We never see your card details.
- **Discord** hosts the community where picks are posted.
- **The Slam Dunk Dashboard** at app.slamdunk.bet asks you to sign in with Discord or Google so it can confirm you're an active subscriber. It stores the account identifier those services return and nothing else from your profile.

## Advertising and affiliate links

This site shows no ads and has no affiliate links. We do advertise Slam Dunk Bets on other platforms, and to measure whether those ads work, every page loads the **Whop Pixel**, a script from Whop, the company that processes some of our subscriptions. It records page views and the ad or link that brought you here, may set cookies or similar identifiers, and lets Whop connect a visit to a later purchase on Whop and report that conversion to the ad platform that referred you. Whop handles this data under its own privacy policy. A content blocker or blocking third-party scripts in your browser turns it off.

If we add affiliate links or on-site ads in the future, any page that contains them will say so plainly, and this policy will be updated to describe any additional data collection.

## Children

This site and our services are for adults 21 and over. We don't knowingly collect information from anyone under 21.

## Changes and contact

If this policy changes, we'll update the effective date above. Questions about your data: [slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com](mailto:slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com).
